description: Overview of a whole NT chapter (or a verse range): WHICH verses differ between the loaded Greek editions (byzantine, tr, sblgnt), and in what words. One call instead of comparing verse by verse. Lists only the differing verses with the differing edition pairs, counts per pair, and marks verses where the TAGNT apparatus notes a meaning variant. It does not classify a difference and carries no per-word attestation: for a verse of interest call bible_compare. NT only.

verses.description: Optional: restrict to verses, range "1-12" or list "3,7,9". Omit for the whole chapter.

name: bible_compare_chapter

identisch.description: Verse list of the checked verses on which all loaded editions agree.

paare.description: Per edition pair, how many of the checked verses differ.

tagnt_bedeutungsvarianten.description: Verse list of all checked verses where the TAGNT apparatus notes a meaning variant, whether or not the loaded editions differ there.

verse.description: Only the verses that differ, each with only the pairs that differ.

tagnt_bedeutungsvariante.description: The TAGNT apparatus notes a meaning variant at this verse. A statement about the apparatus, not about the editions compared here.

verse_mit_unterschied.description: Verses that differ in at least one edition pair. Take this number; do not count the list.
